original: ekākṣaropaniṣat
analyzed: eka akṣara upaniṣad

original: ekākṣarapadārūḍhaṃ sarvātmakamakhaṇḍitam | sarvavarjitacinmātraṃ tripānnārāyaṇaṃ bhaje || oṃ saha nāvavatu saha nau bhunaktu | saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai | tejasvināvadhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahai || oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
analyzed: ekākṣara pada ārūḍham sarva ātmakam akhaṇḍitam sarva varjita cit mātram tripād nārāyaṇam bhaje om saha nau avatu saha nau bhunaktu saha vīryam karavāvahai tejasvinau adhītam astu mā vidviṣāvahai om śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ

original: hariḥ oṃ
analyzed: hariḥ om

original: ekākṣaraṃ tvakṣare'trāsti some suṣumnāyāṃ ceha dṛḍhī sa ekaḥ |
analyzed: eka akṣaram tu akṣaretrā asti some suṣumnāyām ca iha dṛḍhī saḥ ekaḥ

original: tvaṃ viśvabhūrbhūtapatiḥ purāṇaḥ parjanya eko bhuvanasya goptā || 1||
analyzed: tvam viśva bhūḥ bhūtapatiḥ purāṇaḥ parjanyaḥ ekaḥ bhuvanasya goptā

original: viśve nimagnapadavīḥ kavīnāṃ tvaṃ jātavedo bhuvanasya nāthaḥ |
analyzed: viśve nimagna padavīḥ kavīnām tvam jātavedaḥ bhuvanasya nāthaḥ

original: ajātamagre sa hiraṇyaretā yajñaistvamevaikavibhuḥ purāṇaḥ || 2||
analyzed: ajātam agre sa hiraṇyaretāḥ yajñaiḥ tvam eva eka vibhuḥ purāṇaḥ

original: prāṇaḥ prasūtirbhuvanasya yonirvyāptaṃ tvayā ekapadena viśvam |
analyzed: prāṇaḥ prasūtiḥ bhuvanasya yoniḥ vyāptam tvayā eka padena viśvam

original: tvaṃ viśvabhūryonipāraḥ svagarbhe kumāra eko viśikhaḥ sudhanvā || 3||
analyzed: tvam viśva bhūḥ yoni pāraḥ sva garbhe kumāraḥ ekaḥ viśikhaḥ su dhanvā

original: vitatya bāṇaṃ taruṇārkavarṇaṃ vyomāntare bhāsi hiraṇyagarbhaḥ |
analyzed: vitatya bāṇam taruṇa arka varṇam vyoma antare bhāsi hiraṇyagarbhaḥ

original: bhāsā tvayā vyomni kṛtaḥ sutārkṣyastavaṃ vai kumārastvamariṣṭanemiḥ || 4||
analyzed: bhāsā tvayā vyomni kṛtaḥ su tārkṣyaḥ tavam vai kumāraḥ tvam ariṣṭanemiḥ

original: tvaṃ vajrabhṛdbhūtapatistvameva kāmaḥ prajānāṃ nihito'si some |
analyzed: tvam vajrabhṛt bhūtapatiḥ tvam eva kāmaḥ prajānām nihitaḥ asi some

original: svāhā svadhā yacca vaṣaṭ karoti rudraḥ paśūnāṃ guhayā nimagnaḥ || 5||
analyzed: svāhā svadhā yat ca vaṣaṭ karoti rudraḥ paśūnām guhayā nimagnaḥ

original: dhātā vidhātā pavanaḥ suparṇo viṣṇurvarāho rajanī rahaśca |
analyzed: dhātā vidhātā pavanaḥ suparṇaḥ viṣṇuḥ varāhaḥ rajanī rahaḥ ca

original: bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyatprabhavaḥ kriyāśca kālaḥ kramastvaṃ paramākṣaraṃ ca || 6||
analyzed: bhūtam bhaviṣyat prabhavaḥ kriyāḥ ca kālaḥ kramaḥ tvam parama akṣaram ca

original: ṛco yajūṃśi prasavanti vaktrātsāmāni samrāḍvasuvantarikṣam |
analyzed: ṛcaḥ prasavanti vaktrāt sāmāni samrāj vasu antarikṣam

original: tvaṃ yajñanetā hutabhugvibhuśca rudrāstatha daityagaṇā vasuśca || 7||
analyzed: tvam yajñanetā hutabhuj vibhuḥ ca rudrāḥ daitya gaṇāḥ vasuḥ ca

original: sa eṣa devo'mbaragaśca cakre anye'bhyadhiṣṭheta tamo nirundhyaḥ |
analyzed: saḥ eṣa deva umbara gaḥ ca cakre anyebhyaḥ adhiṣṭheta tamaḥ nirundhyaḥ

original: hiraṇmayaṃ yasya vibhāti sarvaṃ vyomāntare raśmimivāṃśunābhiḥ || 8||
analyzed: hiraṇmayam yasya vibhāti sarvam vyoma antare raśmim iva aṃśu nābhiḥ

original: sa sarvavettā bhuvanasya goptā tābhiḥ prajānāṃ nihitā janānām |
analyzed: sa sarva vettā bhuvanasya goptā tābhiḥ prajānām nihitāḥ janānām

original: protā tvamotā vicitiḥ kramāṇāṃ prajāpatiśchandamayo vigarbhaḥ || 9||
analyzed: protā tvam otā vicitiḥ kramāṇām prajāpatiḥ chanda mayaḥ vigarbhaḥ

original: sāmaiścidanto virajaśca bāhūṃ hiraṇmayaṃ vedavidāṃ variṣṭham |
analyzed: sāmaiḥ cit antaḥ virajaḥ ca bāhūm hiraṇmayam veda vidām variṣṭham

original: yamadhvare brahmavidaḥ stuvanti sāmairyajurbhiḥ kratubhistvameva || 10||
analyzed: yam adhvare brahma vidaḥ stuvanti sāmaiḥ yajurbhiḥ kratubhiḥ tvam eva

original: tvaṃ strī pumāṃstvaṃ ca kumāra ekastvaṃ vai kumārī hyatha bhūstvameva |
analyzed: tvam strī pumān tvam ca kumāraḥ ekaḥ tvam vai kumārī hi atha bhūḥ tvam eva

original: tvameva dhātā varuṇaśca rājā tvaṃ vatsaro'gnyaryama eva sarvam || 11||
analyzed: tvam eva dhātā varuṇaḥ ca rājā tvam vatsara ugniḥ aryamā eva sarvam

original: mitraḥ suparṇaścandra indro rudrastvaṣṭā viṣṇuḥ savitā gopatistvam |
analyzed: mitraḥ suparṇaḥ candraḥ indraḥ rudraḥ tvaṣṭā viṣṇuḥ savitā gopatiḥ tvam

original: tvaṃ viṣṇurbhūtāni tu trāsi daityāṃstvayāvṛtaṃ jagadudbhavagarbhaḥ || 12||
analyzed: tvam viṣṇuḥ bhūtāni tu trāsi daityān tvayā āvṛtam jagat udbhava garbhaḥ

original: tvaṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svastvaṃ hi svayambhūratha viśvatomukhaḥ |
analyzed: tvam bhūḥ bhuvaḥ svar tvam hi svayambhūḥ atha viśvatomukhaḥ

original: ya evaṃ nityaṃ vedayate guhāśayaṃ prabhuṃ purāṇaṃ sarvabhūtaṃ hiraṇmayam || 13||
analyzed: yaḥ evam nityam vedayate guhā āśayam prabhum purāṇam sarva bhūtam hiraṇmayam

original: hiraṇmayaṃ buddhimatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ sa buddhimānbuddhimatītya tiṣṭhatītyupaniṣat ||
analyzed: hiraṇmayam buddhimatām parām gatim sa buddhimān buddhim atītya tiṣṭhati iti upaniṣad

original: oṃ saha nāvavatu saha nau bhunaktu |
analyzed: om saha nau avatu saha nau bhunaktu

original: saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai |
analyzed: saha vīryam karavāvahai

original: tejasvināvadhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahai ||
analyzed: tejasvinau adhītam astu mā vidviṣāvahai

original: oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
analyzed: om śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ

original: ityekākṣaropaniṣatsamāptā ||
analyzed: iti ekākṣara upaniṣad samāptā
